title: Samsung proposes AI privacy button but Google Analytics and ad SDKs still collect data
content_md:
Samsung proposes AI privacy button but Google Analytics and ad SDKs still collect data

Samsung introduced an "AI privacy" toggle in its settings, but Google Analytics, advertising SDKs, and Play services continue to collect user data regardless of the setting. The Android Police investigation found the toggle does not actually stop data collection by Google services.

via https://www.androidpolice.com/samsungs-ai-privacy-switch-doesnt-stop-google-collecting-your-data/
